## Purpose and entry points
AgentField is an AI-agent control plane: application-defined Python, Go, or TypeScript agents register callable capabilities; the platform routes calls, manages durable execution, governance, memory, and observability. Main binaries are the server (`control-plane/cmd/agentfield-server/main.go`), CLI (`control-plane/cmd/af/main.go`), and macOS tray companion (`control-plane/cmd/af-tray/main.go`). SDK entry surfaces are `sdk/python/agentfield/agent.py`, `sdk/go/agent/agent.go`, and `sdk/typescript/src/agent/Agent.ts`.

## Control-plane composition and API boundary
The Go server assembles storage, services, background maintenance, authentication, and HTTP/gRPC routing. Route groups separate core execution, agentic/discovery, memory, triggers, governance, connector, and UI APIs: `control-plane/internal/server/server.go`, `control-plane/internal/server/routes_core.go`, `control-plane/internal/server/routes_agentic.go`. HTTP handlers are the ingress boundary; they validate/authorize requests and invoke shared services rather than exposing storage directly: `control-plane/internal/handlers/execute.go`, `control-plane/internal/handlers/route_registrar.go`.

## Agent mesh and execution lifecycle
Agents auto-register nodes, versions, reasoners, and health with the control plane. An execution request resolves a target/version, applies admission and policy guards, records lifecycle state, dispatches to the remote agent, and supports sync, async, cancellation, pause/approval, restart, status, logs, and SSE. Workflow parent-child relationships form the persisted DAG. Core paths: `control-plane/internal/handlers/execute_lifecycle.go`, `control-plane/internal/handlers/workflow_dag.go`, `control-plane/internal/services/cancel_dispatcher.go`.

## SDK-hosted agent runtime
SDKs turn decorated functions into agent HTTP endpoints and provide the outbound control-plane client. They propagate execution/workflow/session context for nested `app.call()` fan-out, report status/logs/usage, and implement local reasoner routing. Python additionally has async and serverless runtimes. Relevant paths: `sdk/python/agentfield/agent_server.py`, `sdk/python/agentfield/connection_manager.py`, `sdk/go/agent/router.go`; `sdk/typescript/src/context/ExecutionContext.ts`.

## Persistence, memory, and eventing
The platform uses a local database abstraction with SQLite and PostgreSQL support, schema migrations, transactions/locks, execution records, triggers, identity data, and workflow state. It provides scoped key-value/vector memory and embedding-provider integration; in-process events distribute execution/node/reasoner/trigger/memory changes. Key paths: `control-plane/internal/storage/storage.go`, `control-plane/internal/storage/vector_store.go`, `control-plane/migrations/011_create_workflow_runs_and_steps.sql`; `control-plane/internal/events/event_bus.go`.

## Identity, authorization, and integration ingress
DID and verifiable-credential services establish agent identity and signed audit/provenance chains. Middleware enforces API, DID, permission, privileged/admin, rate-limit, and connector-capability boundaries. Trigger sources ingest and authenticate cron, GitHub, Slack, Stripe, Databricks, Linear, Sentry, and Snowflake events before dispatching workflows. Paths: `control-plane/internal/services/did_service.go`, `control-plane/internal/services/vc_service.go`, `control-plane/internal/server/middleware/permission.go`; `control-plane/internal/handlers/triggers.go`.

## Operator surfaces and deployment
The CLI scaffolds, installs, runs, manages and verifies agent packages; package services handle repository acquisition, language runtimes, credentials, process control, and registration. A React/Vite dashboard consumes UI APIs and SSE to manage fleet state and render workflow DAGs. Deployments target Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, and PostgreSQL; the stateless control plane can scale behind a load balancer. Paths: `control-plane/internal/cli/root.go`, `control-plane/internal/packages/installer.go`; `control-plane/web/client/src/main.tsx`, `control-plane/web/client/src/components/WorkflowDAG/index.tsx`; `deployments/helm/agentfield/templates/control-plane-deployment.yaml`.
